lines.speaker: site_engineer
lines.text: Hard hat or off the grade, and I genuinely don't mind which. We pour at six, the schedule is the schedule, and the schedule has never once moved for anybody.

lines.speaker: site_engineer
lines.text: Four hundred megawatts of cooling, they've specced. I've built three of these. I have never seen a spec ask for that much cooling for a logistics shed, and I've said so, in writing, twice.

lines.speaker: site_engineer
lines.text: Ask the camp clerk about the payroll if you want something to lose sleep over. I stopped asking in week nine and I sleep fine now, which I'm aware is not the same as being right.

lines.speaker: site_engineer
lines.text: You lot keep looking at that frame like you know what goes in it. If you do, don't tell me at work. Tell me after, when I've finished the pour.
